name: YNX Quant Lab
title: YNX Quant Lab — Research, Paper and Bounded Testnet
metaDescription: Research, backtest and inspect strategies with explicit data, risk and Wallet authorization boundaries. Historical and simulated results do not predict returns.
h1: Research strategies with evidence before execution
risks: historical and simulated results do not predict returns
provider and network failures can delay or prevent execution

faq.question: Does YNX Quant Lab guarantee returns?
faq.answer: No. Historical, backtested, paper and Testnet results do not predict returns, and users bear strategy gains and losses.

faq.question: Can Quant Lab withdraw my assets?
faq.answer: No. Quant Lab does not receive Wallet keys or withdrawal rights. Bounded execution requires a revocable Wallet mandate.

faq.question: Where do assets remain?
faq.answer: Assets remain in the user's Exchange subaccount or DEX Strategy Vault under the owning product's controls.
